title: sourceledger sources.toml
description: The manifest sourceledger fetches, builds and validates: one [[source]] table per input.

output_format.description: The project's table output format. CSV unless set; Parquet needs the parquet extra.

release_formats.description: The optional metadata files release writes beside SHA256SUMS. None unless set.

source.description: One input. Keys other than these are kept, for a project's own reader.

id.description: ASCII letters, digits, _ and -. Names the raw file and the output.

status.description: implemented: read by every stage. unimplemented: known, not read yet.

url.description: What fetch downloads. No user name or password: send those in headers.

terms.description: The publisher's reuse terms, in their words.

terms_url.description: Where the terms are stated. No user name or password.

license.description: The terms as an SPDX id, or LicenseRef-<name>.

redistribute.description: Whether the terms let you republish the raw file.

vintage.description: The edition you expect: text or a TOML date.

output_format.description: Project-wide: set it above the first [[source]].

release_formats.description: Project-wide: set it above the first [[source]].

sha256.description: The SHA-256 the download must have.

max_bytes.description: The largest download fetch accepts. 200 MiB unless set.

timeout_s.description: The time budget in seconds for a fetch, including retries and waits. 300 unless set.

format.description: file: keep the original bytes without a table. Otherwise choose the reader, or infer it from the URL extension.

sheet.description: The Excel sheet to read. The first unless set.

headers.description: Extra request headers, each value an environment variable: "env:NAME". Needs an https url.

archive.description: Ask the Internet Archive to snapshot the URL after a fetch that brings new bytes.

reason.description: A note for people. Not read.
